repairs.text: Comprensió oral. Quina parada em queda més a prop?
repairs.pronunciation: Read the complete exercise introduction and title exactly once in the warm older male Ferran/Algenib voice.

repairs.text: Bon dia. Voldria un bitllet per anar a Portell de Mar aquesta tarda. M’han deixat una habitació prop del passeig de la Marina, però aquí no em conec gens les parades.
repairs.pronunciation: Read the complete opening Bon dia and all the following sentences in the warm older male Ferran/Algenib voice. This whole opening turn was omitted previously; do not skip it.
